state.product: The Daily Consensus — an attributed, free public morning board and archived editions. Reader wants the shortest no-signup route to actual US ETF off-exchange reports.
existingDesign: Manrope, Space Grotesk; light and dark --panel, --text, --text-secondary, --border, --accent; no return-direction colors for activity

Existing panel/panelHead, display metrics and 44px source links. The big picture has reviewed developments, rates, FX and Taiwan, then collapsed Policy, positioning & capital. MorningBoard has MARKET, SPY, QQQ, IWM, DIA, TLT and history.
semantics: ETF-specific weekly ATS and non-ATS tables are read on a third-party publisher and linked on reader action. Separate link to the official FINRA portal; portal presents its own terms. Table data never enter this site, archives, scores or forecasts.

Two separately sourced 2026 Q3 financial filings of operating metrics compared to Q3 2025: Nasdaq reporting facility percentage of US-listed share volume and BIDS Trading average daily touched shares in millions. These are national venue context restricted to MARKET, with separate units, filings and dates; an ETF page must not inherit the market-wide numbers.
Only editions that saved these filings can show those observations; time-varying external readers are current-only. The product still lacks its own weekly ETF feed.
accessibility: 375/768/1280px; accessible names and heading; top-level links, no embeds or automatic provider requests. Current MARKET needs one-click choices for five ETFs, a selected ETF needs only its own direct report.
state.goal: Give reader a visible way to reach real weekly volume while making the source/period/scope of the observed on-site numbers unambiguous.

placement.instructions: Where can the reader most easily find the no-login weekly source without mistaking it for the consensus? All candidates must support a reliable shareable #off-exchange link on a fresh visit.

criteria.before_research: A self-contained standard width panel directly before the collapsed research sections, below the existing international panel.
criteria.after_developments: A self-contained standard width panel immediately after reviewed developments, before the current rates and currency panels.
criteria.positioning_with_entry: A visible weekly-report entry before collapsed research and a separate archival metric panel within Policy, positioning & capital.

metrics.instructions: Select the clearest way for the market view to show a percent and a share count with two comparable quarters each.

criteria.separate_rows: Two labelled rows with the current figure, prior year figure and dated filing link on each. Rows stack naturally on phones.
criteria.paired_tiles: Two calm side-by-side tiles, stacking on phones, each with its own unit, current number, prior-year comparator and filing link.
criteria.table: Accessible table, with separate measure and unit text plus columns for both quarters and filing references.

weekly_access.instructions: Select the most direct link treatment across MARKET and ETF views.

criteria.ticker_links: One plain-language heading and five named 44px ETF report links on MARKET; selected ETF shows one fully named primary link. Official FINRA portal is the secondary link.
criteria.list: List five full-name ETF reports with distinct link labels on MARKET; filter to one when a specific ETF is selected. Official source follows.
